name: Shirotori (Kagawa, Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Shirotori town emblem in black: a stylised swirl with horizontal strokes, like a bird.
history: Flag of the former town of Shirotori in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1960.

features.role: Shirotori town emblem — a stylised swirl with horizontal strokes, like a bird
